title: SignInForm
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with MonarchSignInWithRookButton, MonarchButton, MonarchDivider, MonarchInlineNotice, MonarchTextField (autofill content type Username and EmailAddress), MonarchPasswordInput (current-password purpose), MonarchLink and MonarchCheckboxRow; the app's androidx.credentials Credential Manager for passkeys
summary: A recipe, not a component: sign in with an email and password, a passkey or single sign-on, with field errors, a form error, Keep me signed in, and links to reset the password and create an account.
whenToUse: For the sign-in screen of an app that has its own accounts.
whenNotToUse: When the app signs in only with Rook ID, show MonarchSignInWithRookButton alone. To reset a password use the PasswordResetForm recipe; to re-confirm a signed-in person use MonarchStepUpAuthDialog.
api: MonarchButton(text = "Sign in with a passkey", onClick = …, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())

MonarchTextField(value = email, onValueChange = …, modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentType = ContentType.Username + ContentType.EmailAddress }, label = "Email", errorText = emailError, keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Email, autoCorrectEnabled = false))

MonarchPasswordInput(value = password, onValueChange = …, label = "Password", errorText = passwordError, purpose = MonarchPasswordInputPurpose.Current, keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onDone = { signIn() }))
MonarchCheckboxRow(checked = keepSignedIn, onCheckedChange = …, label = "Keep me signed in")
MonarchButton(text = "Sign in", onClick = signIn, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary, loading = signingIn)

options.name: emailError
options.description: An empty or malformed email, shown on the field before anything is sent.

options.name: passwordError
options.description: An empty password, shown on the field.

options.name: formError
options.description: A wrong email or password or a server failure, in a danger MonarchInlineNotice above the fields. One message for both, so the form does not reveal which accounts exist.

options.name: signingIn
options.description: Passed to the Sign in button's loading while the request runs.

options.name: keepSignedIn
options.description: Sent with the request; the session length is the app's.

states.name: ready
states.description: Single sign-on and passkey buttons, an "or" divider, the email and password fields, Forgot password?, Keep me signed in, Sign in and Create an account.

states.name: field errors
states.description: An empty or malformed email and an empty password show their errors on the fields before anything is sent.

states.name: signing in
states.description: Sign in shows its progress indicator and reads "Loading".

states.name: failed
states.description: A wrong password or a server failure goes in a danger MonarchInlineNotice above the fields.

states.name: passkey
states.description: The passkey button starts the app's Credential Manager request, which shows the system passkey sheet; a cancelled sheet changes nothing.

appearance: Every part is an existing Monarch component: the Rook ID button, a secondary passkey button, a divider with a muted "or", outlined fields with their errors, a checkbox row, links and a full-width primary button. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web's SignInForm is one component with an onSubmit that returns errors and its own messages. On Android, as on iOS, it is a recipe, because the request, the session and navigation belong to the app. Autofill comes from the content types: Username and EmailAddress on the email field and the Password type that MonarchPasswordInput's current purpose sets, so autofill services and Google Password Manager offer saved passwords. Passkey sign-in is the app's Credential Manager call (androidx.credentials GetCredentialRequest with a GetPublicKeyCredentialOption), which shows the system sheet; Monarch does not depend on androidx.credentials. The web's identifier modes (username, email or username) are the field's label, keyboard type and content type.
accessibility: The title has the heading semantics.
Field errors come from MonarchTextField and MonarchPasswordInput, which show them in words and mark the fields as in error.
The "or" divider is decorative and hidden from TalkBack.
Keep me signed in is a MonarchCheckboxRow: one element with the checkbox role and its state.
Forgot password? and Create an account are MonarchLinks; the buttons are MonarchButtons with 48dp targets and a loading state.
The system passkey sheet is the system's.
edgeCases: Do not say whether the email or the password was wrong; use one form error.
Trim spaces around the email but never change the password.
With passkey or single sign-on only, leave out the password field, Forgot password? and Keep me signed in.
Never save the password in the instance state; keep it in remember, not rememberSaveable.

examples.title: Email and password (password: demo-password)
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4)) {
    formError?.let { MonarchInlineNotice(message = it, tone = MonarchTone.Danger) }
    MonarchTextField(
        value = email,
        onValueChange = { email = it },
        modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentType = ContentType.Username + ContentType.EmailAddress },
        label = "Email",
        required = true,
        errorText = emailError,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Email, autoCorrectEnabled = false),
    )
    MonarchPasswordInput(
        value = password,
        onValueChange = { password = it },
        label = "Password",
        required = true,
        errorText = passwordError,
        purpose = MonarchPasswordInputPurpose.Current,
        keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onDone = { signIn() }),
        labelAction = {
            MonarchLink(
                text = "Forgot password?",
                onClick = { /* Open the password reset. */ },
                variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Standalone,
            )
        },
    )
    MonarchCheckboxRow(checked = keepSignedIn, onCheckedChange = { keepSignedIn = it }, label = "Keep me signed in")
    MonarchButton(
        text = "Sign in",
        onClick = signIn,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
        loading = signingIn,
    )
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space1),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        MonarchText(text = "New here?")
        MonarchLink(
            text = "Create an account",
            onClick = { /* Open sign-up. */ },
            variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Standalone,
        )
    }
}
